name: Agriculture (crops, livestock, fisheries, forestry)
current_contribution: 26.5% of GDP, 65% of jobs, 30% of exports
vision_2050: A highly productive, competitive and sustainable industry making Tanzania a leading regional food hub.
priorities: Irrigation and mechanisation at scale|Value addition and agro-processing|Access to finance and inputs for farmers|Research, extension and climate-smart practices

name: Tourism
vision_2050: Africa's leading tourism destination, expanding into cultural, eco, cruise, hunting and MICE tourism.
priorities: Air, road and rail access to attractions|New segments: cultural, eco, cruise and MICE|A skilled hospitality workforce|Marketing Tanzania as a premier destination

name: Manufacturing
current_contribution: 8.1% of GDP, growing about 8% per year
vision_2050: A globally competitive manufacturing hub moving from raw materials to finished goods.
priorities: Reliable, affordable energy|Special economic zones and industrial parks|A shift from raw materials to finished goods|Skills in engineering and production

name: Construction and Real Estate
current_contribution: Central to urbanisation, housing and infrastructure
vision_2050: Millions of jobs and resilient, sustainable urban spaces.
priorities: Affordable housing finance|Resilient, well-planned urban infrastructure|Local materials and construction skills|Sustainable building standards

name: Mining
vision_2050: A major GDP and export contributor through value addition in gold, gemstones and critical minerals such as graphite, lithium, uranium and rare earths.
priorities: Local value addition and refining|Transparent licensing and governance|Energy and logistics to mine sites|Skills in geology and processing

name: Blue Economy
current_contribution: Extensive coastline and lakes, largely untapped
vision_2050: Marine and freshwater industries including fisheries, coastal tourism, marine transport, LNG and ocean-based energy.
priorities: Fishing fleets, ports and cold chains|Coastal and marine tourism|Sustainable fisheries management|Offshore gas (LNG) and ocean energy

name: Sports and Creative Industries
vision_2050: A leading cultural and sporting hub in Africa spanning music, film, fashion and entertainment.
priorities: Studios, venues and creative hubs|Talent development and training|Intellectual-property protection|Access to finance and global markets

name: Financial Services
current_contribution: Rising demand for banking, insurance and investment
vision_2050: An inclusive, efficient financial system widening access to credit, savings and investment.
priorities: Digital payments and mobile money|Wider access to credit and savings|Capital markets for long-term finance|Sound regulation and consumer trust

name: Services (retail and hospitality)
vision_2050: A dynamic, competitive consumer market driving jobs and revenue.
priorities: Digital platforms and e-commerce|Formalisation of small businesses|Customer-service and trade skills|Urban retail and hospitality infrastructure
